purpose: Summarize modeled G-code replay and its matched previous-plate comparator.

reference_geometry.body: Full commanded modeled paths after machine startup with photo-estimated head geometry and progressively deposited nominal stock.
reference_geometry.local: Nominal rounded-bead surface against the annulus and nozzle cone, separating prior support, prior part and fresh same-run stock. Deposited stock is rigid in the model.
reference_geometry.excludes: Startup macros, firmware moves, bed-level compensation, material compression, departure from nominal stock, and measured fit.
